en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, multi‑storey administrative building with many rectangular windows and a small attached veranda or annex in front. The foreground contains a garden with paths, trees and shrubs. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location in Dresden and specify that it is the administration building of the garrison hospital. A vertical imprint along the left edge lists the publisher.
